briefdescription.para: Kicks off async connection attempts, polling AppModel for the port every 100 ms.

detaileddescription.para: Kicks off async connection attempts to the daemon at 100 ms intervals.
Reads AppModel::getContext()->getPort() on each tick and attempts connectToSocket. On success, stops retrying — JUCE fires connectionMade(). On timeout (50 × 100 ms = 5 s), logs a failure line.

NEXUS PROCESS MESSAGE THREAD — must be called on the message thread.
Reads the port from the .nexus file on disk on each tick for up to 50 ticks (5 seconds total). On a successful socket connect JUCE fires connectionMade(), which sends the hello PDU. On exhaustion, a failure line is logged.

briefdescription.para: Called by JUCE when the socket connects successfully.

detaileddescription.para: Sends the hello PDU to initiate the handshake. The SESSIONS subtree is written later when the daemon's sessions PDU arrives.

briefdescription.para: Called by JUCE when the connection is lost.
Dispatches an incoming message from the host.

detaileddescription.para: Decodes Message kind from the first 2 bytes and delegates to the appropriate private handler method. Mirrors Channel::messageReceived.

PDU kinds handled:
sessions → handleSessions
sessionKilled → handleSessionKilled
output → handleOutput
loading → handleLoading
stateUpdate → handleStateUpdate
all others → ignored (logged in debug)

briefdescription.para: Reacts to session creation on Nexus::events.

detaileddescription.para: When a "SESSION" child is appended to nexus.events in client mode, sends a createSession PDU to the daemon, wires user input to daemon via IPC, and registers this Link as a listener on the session State VT for resize forwarding.

briefdescription.para: Reacts to session removal on Nexus::events.

detaileddescription.para: When a "SESSION" child is removed from nexus.events, sends a remove PDU to the daemon and cleans up the clientSessionStateRoots entry.

briefdescription.para: Detects winsize changes on client-mode session State VTs and forwards a resize PDU to the daemon.

detaileddescription.para: Watches for the winsize property on the TEXT_EDITOR child node. Matches the tree's parent (SESSION root) against clientSessionStateRoots to find the affected UUID. Unpacks the packed Bounds to obtain cols and rows.

briefdescription.para: Handles Message::sessions — rewrites AppModel SESSIONS subtree.

detaileddescription.para: Wire format: uint16_t count | N × (uint32_t len + UTF-8 bytes). Removes the nexus-connect LOADING operation on first receipt.

briefdescription.para: Handles Message::sessionKilled — removes the exited UUID from AppModel.
Handles Message::output — feeds raw PTY bytes into the target Processor.

detaileddescription.para: Payload: uuid (length-prefixed) + raw PTY bytes.

briefdescription.para: Handles Message::loading — receives Grid+State snapshot for restore.

detaileddescription.para: Payload: uuid (length-prefixed) + snapshot bytes. Passes the snapshot to terminal::Session::setStateInformation directly.

briefdescription.para: Handles Message::stateUpdate — writes cwd and foreground process into the target Processor's ValueTree.

detaileddescription.para: Payload: uuid (length-prefixed) + cwd (length-prefixed) + fgProcess (length-prefixed). Both cwd and foregroundProcess are written via direct setProperty on the SESSION ValueTree node (MESSAGE thread). cwd is the authoritative path from OSC 7 as received by the daemon and pushed here. foregroundProcess is the OS process name queried by the daemon on outputBlockTop. Routes via Nexus::get() — terminal::Session (remote) is owned by the Nexus sessions map.

briefdescription.para: JUCE IPC client connector to a remote Nexus daemon.

detaileddescription.para: Owned privately by Nexus in client mode. No external caller instantiates or holds a pointer to Link directly.
